title: RAW Bodycam Footage Of Cops Shooting Armed Hospital Patient
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
The police body camera footage released on Monday by Huntersville Police Department shows the incident which occurred in September 2017. Huntersville police officers said they shot 76-year-old James Charles Cook after he pointed a gun at one officer. The Mecklenburg County District Attorney's Office has ruled the Sept. 10, 2017 shooting justified.
